title: Denial measures in coastal Bengal
detail: Amid invasion fears, colonial authorities implemented denial measures in parts of Bengal, including removal or restriction of boats and rice stocks. The measures disrupted local transport and provisioning; historians debate their significance.

title: Quit India resolution adopted
detail: The All-India Congress Committee adopted the Quit India resolution in Bombay, calling for an end to British rule. Bengal’s campaign developed amid wartime restrictions and local political organization.

title: Congress leaders arrested
detail: The colonial government arrested leading Congress figures after the resolution. Bengal’s response varied by locality and included rural activism and revolutionary-party activity.
